description: Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) totals grouped by NAICS industry code, borrower state, or servicing lender: loan count, total approved, loans and dollars forgiven, forgiveness rate, and total jobs reported. Optionally scoped to one borrower state. Answers "which industries got the most PPP money in Texas" or "which lenders serviced the most PPP dollars". Business borrowers only (sole proprietors and individuals excluded). Source: SBA PPP FOIA data, as of 2024-09-30.

order_by.description: Rank by total approved amount (default), loan count, or jobs reported.

state.description: Optional 2-letter borrower state code to scope before grouping.
